requests.name: entsoe_day_ahead_prices
requests.meaning_en: Cleared day-ahead wholesale electricity prices for each market time unit in a bidding zone.
requests.meaning_zh: 报价区内每个市场时段的日前批发电力出清价格，用于分析现货价格水平、峰谷价差和价格波动。

requests.name: entsoe_actual_total_load
requests.meaning_en: Measured total electricity demand in a bidding zone or control area.
requests.meaning_zh: 报价区或控制区实际发生的总用电负荷，可用于负荷曲线、峰值需求和供需平衡分析。

requests.name: entsoe_day_ahead_load_forecast
requests.meaning_en: The system operator's day-ahead forecast of total electricity demand.
requests.meaning_zh: 系统运营商在日前阶段发布的总负荷预测，可与实际负荷比较以衡量预测误差。

requests.name: entsoe_week_ahead_load_forecast
requests.meaning_en: Forecast total electricity demand for the coming week.
requests.meaning_zh: 未来一周的总负荷预测，适用于周度运行计划和需求趋势分析。

requests.name: entsoe_month_ahead_load_forecast
requests.meaning_en: Forecast total electricity demand for the coming month.
requests.meaning_zh: 未来一个月的总负荷预测，适用于月度电量安排和中期需求判断。

requests.name: entsoe_year_ahead_load_forecast
requests.meaning_en: Long-term forecast of total electricity demand for the coming year.
requests.meaning_zh: 未来一年的长期总负荷预测，适用于年度供需平衡和资源充裕度研究。

requests.name: entsoe_year_ahead_forecast_margin
requests.meaning_en: Expected margin between available generation resources and demand.
requests.meaning_zh: 预计可用发电资源与负荷需求之间的裕度，用于判断年度电力充裕性风险。

requests.name: entsoe_installed_capacity_by_type
requests.title_zh: 按发电类型划分的装机容量
requests.meaning_en: Installed generation capacity grouped by production source such as nuclear, gas, wind, solar, and hydro.
requests.meaning_zh: 按核电、燃气、风电、光伏、水电等能源类型统计的装机容量，用于研究电源结构。

requests.name: entsoe_actual_generation_by_type
requests.title_zh: 按发电类型划分的实际发电量
requests.meaning_en: Actual electricity generation grouped by production source for each time interval.
requests.meaning_zh: 每个时段按能源类型统计的实际发电功率或电量，可用于分析电源结构和新能源占比。

requests.name: entsoe_actual_generation_by_unit
requests.title_zh: 按发电机组划分的实际发电量
requests.meaning_en: Actual output of individual generation units where publication rules permit.
requests.meaning_zh: 在披露规则允许时提供单台发电机组的实际出力，用于机组运行和停启状态研究。

requests.name: entsoe_day_ahead_generation_forecast
requests.meaning_en: Day-ahead forecast of aggregate generation in the selected area.
requests.meaning_zh: 所选区域日前阶段的总发电预测，可与负荷预测和实际发电数据结合分析。

requests.name: entsoe_wind_solar_forecast
requests.meaning_en: Forecast generation from wind and solar production types, identified by PSR type.
requests.meaning_zh: 按PSR能源类型区分的风电和光伏预测出力，用于新能源预测误差及消纳分析。

requests.name: entsoe_water_reservoirs
requests.meaning_en: Stored energy or filling information for water reservoirs and hydro storage plants.
requests.meaning_zh: 水库及水电储能设施的蓄能或库容信息，用于水电可用性和季节性能源储备分析。

requests.name: entsoe_cross_border_physical_flows
requests.meaning_en: Measured physical electricity flow from one domain to another.
requests.meaning_zh: 两个区域之间实际测量的电力物理潮流，方向由输入区域和输出区域共同确定。

requests.name: entsoe_commercial_schedules
requests.meaning_en: Scheduled commercial electricity exchange between two domains.
requests.meaning_zh: 两个区域之间市场参与者计划执行的商业电力交换，与实际物理潮流可能不同。

requests.name: entsoe_forecasted_transfer_capacity
requests.meaning_en: Forecast transfer capacity available on a border for the selected market horizon.
requests.meaning_zh: 指定市场周期内跨区联络线预计可用的传输容量，用于跨区交易能力分析。

requests.name: entsoe_offered_transfer_capacity
requests.title_zh: 日前可供交易的跨境容量
requests.meaning_en: Transfer capacity offered to the day-ahead market on a border.
requests.meaning_zh: 跨区边界向日前市场提供的可交易传输容量，反映市场耦合可利用的网络空间。

requests.name: entsoe_imbalance_prices
requests.meaning_en: Settlement prices applied to positive or negative system and balance-responsible-party imbalances.
requests.meaning_zh: 对系统或平衡责任方正负不平衡电量进行结算的价格，用于平衡成本和偏差风险分析。

requests.name: entsoe_total_imbalance_volumes
requests.meaning_en: Total positive and negative imbalance volumes in a control area.
requests.meaning_zh: 控制区内正、负不平衡电量的总量，用于判断系统实时供需偏差。

requests.name: entsoe_activated_balancing_energy_prices
requests.meaning_en: Prices paid for balancing energy that was activated by the system operator.
requests.meaning_zh: 系统运营商实际激活的平衡能源对应价格，用于研究实时调节资源成本。

requests.name: entsoe_contracted_reserves
requests.title_en: Volumes and Prices of Contracted Reserves
requests.title_zh: 已签约备用容量及价格
requests.meaning_en: Procured reserve capacity volumes and prices for balancing services.
requests.meaning_zh: 为平衡服务采购的备用容量数量及价格，用于辅助服务采购成本分析。

requests.name: entsoe_production_unit_outages
requests.meaning_en: Planned and unplanned reductions in the availability of production units.
requests.meaning_zh: 生产单元计划或非计划不可用及可用能力下降信息，用于判断潜在供应缺口。

requests.name: entsoe_generation_unit_outages
requests.meaning_en: Detailed planned and unplanned generation-unit outages where disclosure thresholds are met.
requests.meaning_zh: 达到披露门槛的发电机组计划及非计划停运信息，可用于机组可用率和供应风险分析。

requests.name: entsoe_consumption_unit_outages
requests.title_zh: 用电单元聚合不可用情况
requests.meaning_en: Aggregated unavailability of large consumption units.
requests.meaning_zh: 大型用电单元不可用能力的聚合披露，用于分析工业负荷中断对系统需求的影响。

requests.name: entsoe_transmission_outages
requests.title_zh: 输电基础设施不可用情况
requests.meaning_en: Planned and unplanned outages affecting transmission infrastructure between domains.
requests.meaning_zh: 影响两个区域之间输电基础设施的计划和非计划停运，用于评估跨区容量约束。

requests.name: entsoe_offshore_grid_outages
requests.title_zh: 海上电网基础设施不可用情况
requests.meaning_en: Outages affecting offshore grid infrastructure and connected offshore generation.
requests.meaning_zh: 海上电网基础设施及其连接海上发电资源的停运信息，用于海上风电送出风险分析。
